questions.question: In the given bar – chart, the ratio of total sales of all branches (in thousand numbers) for the year 2000 to 2001 is∶
questions.solution:
Total sale of books for all branches for 2000 = 80 + 75 + 95 + 85 + 75 + 70 = 480

questions.question: The ratio of the number of neon lamps having a life of 900 hours or more to the number of lamps having life less than 700 hours is:
questions.solution:
Number of lamps having a life of 900 hrs or more = 70 + 55 + 35 = 160

Number of lamps having a life less than 700 hrs = 75 + 60 + 45 = 180

Required ratio = 160 : 180 = 8 : 9

questions.question: In the given bar-chart, which month sales shows the maximum increases in 2018 as against 2017?
questions.solution:

In 2016 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 52%

In 2017 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 60%

In 2018 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 72%

In 2019 percentage of pass student in class 10th = 71%

**Concept :- **

Average = (Sum of all percentage of student pass)/(Total number of years)

**Calculation :-**

⇒ Average = (52% + 60% + 72% +71%)/4

⇒ Average = (255%)/4

⇒ Average of pass percentage of the 10th class for all four years = 63.75%

**∴ Average of pass percentage of the 10th class for all four years** **= 63.75%**

questions.question:
The following bar graph represents the population of a city (in lakhs) as per the census across different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/219552237f9468b4d6e2f07b5f274d58df3309045cf5c3a3bdd7f297d30389a3.png] 

What is the per cent increase in population from 1951 to 2001?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The population of the city (in lakhs) for the years 1951 and 2001 is as follows:

Population in 1951 = 25 lakhs

Population in 2001 = 61 lakhs

**Formula used:**

Percentage Increase = [(Final Population - Initial Population) / Initial Population] × 100

**Calculation:**

Percentage Increase = [(61 - 25) / 25] × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = (36 / 25) × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 1.44 × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 144%

**∴ The percentage increase in population from 1951 to 2001 is 144%.**
